description:
In an era where social media connects people all over the world, high school senior Seongsil has maintained a decade-long penpal friendship with Jessie—a friend she's never met in real life. Stressed out by college entrance exams, Seongsil impulsively suggests meeting face-to-face, and to her surprise, Jessie eagerly agrees to visit Korea. On the day of their long-awaited meeting at the airport, Seongsil expects to find a girl in a yellow hoodie, just like she imagined. But when Jessie arrives, Seongsil is shocked to find that Jessie is a boy! How could the Jessie she knows be a girl in the same grade, yet the person before her is a guy?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/297057685), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61681172), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/penpal), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/penchinso), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000056506), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9649926), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230279), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H044232981), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H044232981)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/yourstruly)

**Note:** The webtoon uses Penchinso name, a shortened version for "Penpal Chinguleul Sogae Habnida (펜팔친구를소개합니다)" (as written on the cover) which means introducing pen pals.
